meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 用测试先行的方式驱动功能开发与缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望在写代码前先通过测试明确预期行为
copy.tagline_en: Write tests first to drive feature development and bug fixes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to define expected behavior with tests before writing code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在做测试驱动开发时会严格按“红→绿”循环:先和你确认要测哪个公开入口,再写失败的测试,接着写刚好够用的代码,一次只做一小步,同时避开测试依赖内部实现等坏写法。
howto.when: 当你想用测试优先的方式开发功能或修 bug,提到“red-green-refactor”,或要求做集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 做购物车结账功能,先写失败的测试。
say.note: Claude 会先跟你确认测试缝,再开始红绿循环。

say.text: 登录模块按垂直切片来,写一个测试就实现一个。
say.note: 一次一小步,测试与实现交替推进。

say.text: 给这个 bug 先写能复现失败的测试,再做最小修复。
say.note: 先红后绿,不提前加多余功能。

howto.what_en: Claude follows the red→green loop: it confirms the seams to test with you, writes a failing test first, then just enough code to pass, one vertical slice at a time, and avoids anti-patterns like tests tied to implementation details.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention 'red-green-refactor', or ask for integration tests.

say_en.text: Use TDD for the shopping cart checkout; write a failing test first.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the seams, then starts the red-green loop.

say_en.text: For the login module, work in vertical slices: one test, then one implementation.
say_en.note: One small step at a time.

say_en.text: For this bug, write a failing reproduction test first, then make the minimal fix.
say_en.note: Red before green, no speculative features.
